WAVE 35 - CONSEQUENCE FOR THIS HANDOFFS TRIAGE LIST. Until a refs/heads/main analysis exists, the platform gate diffs against nothing, so on a 900-file pull request it attributes the entire head tree to the pull request: 94 of the 96 open alerts sit in files the pull request never touched, and the single critical (app/api/discover/route.ts:351) is not in the diff. That is why the real backlog is not 96. After the baseline exists, the triage list is the ABSOLUTE open-alert count on main (GET /code-scanning/alerts?branch=main&state=open), which is expected to be large because the merge carries the whole 900-file branch - and that is the correct, honest number, not something to be reduced by dismissal (CP-060).
